subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Heterogeneous set of generic runtime object lifecycle primitives: 3D buffer-mesh allocation, singly-linked node containers with ID lookup, mutex/thread synchronization objects, Miles audio driver/config/stream objects, and camera/view state handling. The classes below are grouped by shared base layouts and by the packet's DERIVED owner labels; the linked-list cluster (head/tail/cursor/count at this+0x18/0x1C/0x20/0x24 with 12-byte nodes) is the strongest cross-function grouping.

summary: Reconstruction of generic runtime objects from 20 validated function IR records. The packet supplies three DERIVED owners (F3DBufferMesh for 0x00403350, AudioProcessingConfig for 0x004057F0, ChildContainer for 0x00408520); everything else is labeled UNKNOWN and is proposed here as GUESS-level classes. Four functions (0x00407C90, 0x00407FB0, 0x00408000, 0x00408050) share the same container layout (list head at this+0x18, cursor this+0x20, count this+0x24, 12-byte nodes with value at +0, next at +4, ownership flag at +8, node-data ID at +0x5C) and are grouped as one LinkedListContainer. 0x00404AC0 shows an identical node record shape (value/+0, next/+4, flag/+8) under a different container base (list head at obj+0x40) and is kept as a separate RenderNodeList because equal offsets on different bases are not merged. 0x004084B0 is attributed to ChildContainer because it installs the same vtable off_59E60C and zeroes the same child-slot range this+0x10..0x30 that 0x00408520 reads; that membership is a GUESS synthesis flagged in unresolved. Audio, mutex, and camera functions each form single-class clusters with per-class field tables. Free functions 0x00409950/0x004099E0 form the ViewModeControl interface (mutually exclusive toggle of global flag bit 32 and bit 0x8000 of the dword_8AFE88 object).

function_roles.role: (Re)allocates the three 28-byte-record mesh buffers from dimension fields this+0x15C/0x160/0x164/0x168, frees prior allocations via FreeWrapper, and sets the allocated marker at this+0x8 and layout offsets at this+0xC/0x10/0x14.

Remaps array-index parent/child/sibling references into direct 316-byte-stride pointers over a sub-object array (count at this+0x130, array base this+0x134), resetting invalid indices to -1 and zeroing the matching pointers.

Destructor of a render-node list container: walks the singly-linked node list at obj+0x40, conditionally releases node data (via ConditionalFreeWithBit0Flag(1) when the node+8 flag and node+0 data are set), frees each node, zeroes the four list fields obj+0x40..0x4C, frees three auxiliary buffers, then frees the object.

__thiscall default initializer for a camera/view struct: seeds sentinel -1 fields, copies the default directory path via StringCopyWithBufferRealloc, zeroes most dword fields, runs VirtualCleanup on the sub-object at this+0x30, memset-zeroes 44 bytes from index 17, clears the byte at this+0x70 and returns 0.

Audio processing configuration constructor: installs the vtable off_59E490, zeroes the counter at +0x4, seeds sentinel +0x8, copies a path string (default fallback byte_5EA438) and two config dwords, stores three caller params, writes audio factors 0.01f/0.975f/0.5f and sample rate 44100.0f, zeroes state fields and seeds the terminal sentinel +0x60; returns this.

Constructor/initializer of a mutex synchronization object with two-phase setup: three 20-byte file-path slot entries from this+0x10 (StringCopyWithBufferRealloc of byte_5EA438), CreateMutexA into this+0x50, vtable switch off_59E50C to off_59E4EC, timeout 1.0f at +0x4, config param at +0x8, three more slot entries from this+0x1C, and optional MutexLockWithTimeout(0) when the created flag at +0x58 is set; returns this.

Opens a Miles audio stream for an audio-stream slot and starts playback: two modes keyed on the byte at this+0x20 (data-driven MP3-filename open vs path-based track update), AIL_open_stream into this+0xC, then either register/start/volume success path (mutex entry via MutexLockWithTimeout(this,2)) or a three-slot reset failure path.

Initializes the Miles digital audio driver: vtable init dispatch, callback registration, AIL_startup/AIL_set_preference, sample-rate selection from this+0x54 (0->11025, 1->22050, else 44100), AIL_open_digital_driver into this+0x90; on success stores handle, dispatches *this+52, zeroes nine state fields this+0x58..0x84, installs file callbacks, sets this+0x88=1 and returns 0; on failure clears the handle and flag and returns 1.

Removes from the singly linked list the node whose value equals a2, then releases the removed value through its vtable (with argument 1) and frees the node; updates head/tail/cursor at this+0x18/0x1C/0x20 and decrements the count at this+0x24.
Side-effect-free getter: reads the unsigned byte at offset 27 (0x1B) of the caller-supplied structure, extracts bit 5 (shift right 4, mask 2), returns 0 or 2.

__thiscall boolean linked-list lookup: walks from head this+0x18 via cursor this+0x20 comparing each node-data ID (data+0x5C) to a2; returns 1 on match, 0 for a2==-1, empty list, or end-of-list. Legacy ABI label Linked_List_Search_by_ID.
List traversal searching for a node whose data ID (data+0x5C) equals a2; on match invokes sub_406A70 with the matched data object. Returns silently for a2==-1, empty list, or no match.
ID-based linked-list node search returning 1 and running ShortComputation_6a90 (0x00406A90) with output parameters a3/a4 on match; returns 0 otherwise. Called from MemoryAllocation_5160.

Struct reset routine: captures the byte flag at this+0x15, zeroes dwords 0x0/0x4/0xC/0x10, sets 0x8 to 1.0f, zeroes the byte at 0x14, calls ConditionalBranchByFlag(1) as a deactivation notification when the flag was previously active, then clears the flag at 0x15.

Straight-line object constructor: installs the vtable off_59E60C at this+0x0, zeroes this+0x4..0x30 and this+0x38..0x4C, sets the sentinel this+0x34 to -1 and this+0x50 to 2; returns this. Attributed to ChildContainer because it installs the same vtable off_59E60C and zeroes the same child-slot range this+0x10..0x30 that NotifyChildrenTeardown reads (GUESS merge).

Container notify-and-teardown sequence: switches the container vtable to off_59E60C, dispatches each non-null child's vtable-slot-0 method with argument 1 (argument 3 for the child at this+0x20), switches the container vtable to off_59E634, and returns the last dispatch result. Invoked by ConditionalFreeByFlag (00408500).

Switch-based field selector keyed on the float argument bit pattern: nine cases select a dword field from this+0x10..0x30 (case 4 adds 200 * this+0x3C); when the selected value and enable flag this+0x4 are both non-zero it extracts two float components, converts degrees to radians with flt_59E65C, runs sub_542050 and stores the key back into this+0x34.
View-mode enable callback: sets global flag bit 32 via GlobalFlagSetClear(32, 1) and clears bit 0x8000 in the dword at offset 236 of the object at dword_8AFE88; returns the GlobalFlagSetClear result.
View-mode disable callback, inverse of the enable pair: clears global flag bit 32 via GlobalFlagSetClear(32, 0) and sets bit 0x8000 at (dword_8AFE88 + 236); returns the GlobalFlagSetClear result.

Per-frame camera/viewport update: early-returns when the context at this+0x4 is null, sets camera-update flag bit 4096, dispatches on the mode selector at this+0x34 (cases 0-8 + default) to select a per-mode camera sub-object, runs the 3D transform into viewport position/orientation, applies mirror/Euler adjustments, invokes the sub-object update, feeds position/orientation into utility calls, applies a negated chassis transform on flag, and returns a conditional float setter result.

classes.name: F3DBufferMesh
classes.responsibility: 3D buffer mesh object owning three 28-byte-record allocation buffers (index, stream, batch) and the dimension/layout fields that size them. Single packet method performs (re)allocation with free-before-alloc.

classes.name: AudioProcessingConfig
classes.responsibility: Audio processing configuration object (Miles Sound System cluster per corpus prose): constructor installs the vtable off_59E490, copies path/config inputs from the caller record, and initializes audio factor, sample-rate, sentinel and state fields.

classes.name: ChildContainer
classes.responsibility: Container owning nine child pointers (this+0x10..0x30) and two vtable states (off_59E60C then off_59E634). NotifyChildrenTeardown dispatches a vtable-slot-0 method on each child before disposal; the constructor membership (0x004084B0) is a GUESS merge based on the shared off_59E60C vtable and the overlapping zeroed child range.

classes.name: LinkedListNode
classes.responsibility: 12-byte singly-linked list node record: value pointer at +0, next pointer at +4, ownership flag byte at +8. Layout established by 0x00407C90 (explicit node record) and confirmed by the traversal arithmetic of 0x00407FB0/0x00408000/0x00408050 and the identical record shape used by RenderNodeList at 0x00404AC0.

classes.name: LinkedListContainer
classes.responsibility: Singly-linked list container with head at this+0x18, tail at this+0x1C, traversal cursor at this+0x20 and node count at this+0x24; nodes are 12-byte LinkedListNode records whose data objects carry an ID at +0x5C. Provides ID search (0x00407FB0), ID traversal with dispatch (0x00408000), ID lookup with output (0x00408050) and node removal with vtable release (0x00407C90).

classes.name: LinkedListDataRecord
classes.responsibility: Data object stored as a node value (node+0) whose ID field at +0x5C is the lookup key used by the linked-list search functions. The concrete record type is unknown.

classes.name: RenderNodeList
classes.responsibility: Render-node list container (render subsystem per packet prose) destroyed by 0x00404AC0: singly-linked node list at obj+0x40 (12-byte LinkedListNode records), three auxiliary buffers at obj+0x28/0x30/0x38, and four list fields obj+0x40..0x4C zeroed on teardown. Uses the same node record shape as LinkedListContainer but under a different base, so kept separate.

classes.name: MutexSynchronizationObject
classes.responsibility: Mutex/thread synchronization object with a two-phase constructor: file-mutex vtable off_59E50C with three 20-byte path slot entries from this+0x10, OS mutex creation (CreateMutexA into this+0x50, created flag at this+0x58), switch to the thread-object vtable off_59E4EC, then three more slot entries from this+0x1C and optional MutexLockWithTimeout(0).

classes.name: AudioStreamSlot
classes.responsibility: Miles audio-stream slot: stores the driver object, stream handle, path, deserialization sub-struct, track/mode/slot indices and a volume float; opens and starts a stream via AIL and resets its three 20-byte slot groups on open failure.

classes.name: AudioDriver
classes.responsibility: Miles digital audio driver object: vtable-dispatched init, sample-rate selector at this+0x54, driver handle at this+0x90, initialized flag at this+0x88, and nine zeroed state fields this+0x58..0x84 on success.

classes.name: IndexRemappingOwner
classes.responsibility: Object owning a sub-object array (base this+0x134, count this+0x130) whose 316-byte-stride entries carry parent/child/sibling index-pointer pairs; 0x00403540 remaps valid indices into direct pointers and resets invalid ones.

classes.name: CameraViewStruct
classes.responsibility: Camera/view struct whose default initializer (0x00405440) seeds sentinel -1 fields, copies a default directory path, cleans up the sub-object at this+0x30 via VirtualCleanup, and zeroes most of the trailing block. The concrete camera class is unknown.

classes.name: FloatKeyedParamObject
classes.responsibility: Object exposing a set of selectable dword fields keyed on a float argument bit pattern; selection is gated by the enable flag at this+0x4, and case 4 scales the field at this+0x20 by 200 * this+0x3C. The camera-shake interpretation of the degrees-to-radians conversion is DERIVED prose only.

classes.name: ResetStructFlagObject
classes.responsibility: Struct with an activity flag byte at this+0x15 and a 1.0f float at this+0x8; the reset routine (0x004083E0) zeroes its fields and emits a ConditionalBranchByFlag(1) deactivation notification when the flag was previously active.

classes.name: CameraViewportController
classes.responsibility: Per-frame camera/viewport controller: mode selector at this+0x34 picks one of up to nine camera sub-object pointers (this+0x10..0x30), the primary context at this+0x4 gates the update, and mirror/Euler/mode-7/8 offset adjustments modify the resulting viewport transform.

classes.name: BitfieldFlagStruct
classes.responsibility: Caller-supplied structure with a bit-field byte at offset 0x1B whose bit 5 is extracted by the getter 0x00407EF0. The structure type and the meaning of the bit are caller-specific and unknown.

state_machines.name: CameraModeSelector
transitions: The selector dword at this+0x34 selects the active camera sub-object and transform each frame; there is no evidence in the packet of how the selector value itself is changed.

state_machines.name: CameraYOffsetSequencer
transitions: dword_5BE900 cycles 0 -> 1 -> 2 across the mode 7 / mode 8 update calls, adding or subtracting flt_5BE8FC to the sub-object Y offset at +0xC0 (copying through +0xBC/+0xC4); the reset back to 0 occurs outside this function.

interfaces.name: ViewModeControl
interfaces.purpose: Mutually exclusive pair of view-mode callbacks: the enable callback sets global flag bit 32 and clears bit 0x8000 at (dword_8AFE88 + 236); the disable callback performs the inverse. A replacement must keep the two operations inverted relative to each other.

interfaces.name: StringInitializationPattern
interfaces.purpose: Constructors that initialize string/path members through StringCopyWithBufferRealloc (0x00566650), typically with the default path global byte_5EA438 as fallback. Shared by the camera-view struct, audio config, mutex object and audio stream slot constructors.

compatibility_contracts.name: F3DBufferMeshAllocationLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must keep the three 28-byte-record mesh buffers at this+0x150 (index, 28 * indexCount), this+0x154 (stream, 28 * batchCount) and this+0x158 (batch, 28 * batchCount * subBatchMultiplier), sized from the dimension fields this+0x15C/0x160/0x164/0x168, with the allocated marker at this+0x8 set to 1 and layout offsets written to this+0xC/0x10/0x14; existing allocations are freed via 0x00587BCF before reallocation.

compatibility_contracts.name: LinkedListNodeRecordLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Singly-linked list nodes are 12-byte records with the value/data pointer at +0, next pointer at +4 and an ownership flag byte at +8; list containers keep head at this+0x18, tail at this+0x1C, traversal cursor at this+0x20 and count at this+0x24; ID-based lookup reads the node-data ID field at +0x5C and treats -1 as the no-search sentinel.

compatibility_contracts.name: MutexSynchronizationObjectContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The mutex object installs the file-mutex vtable off_59E50C before OS mutex creation (CreateMutexA with a SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES block), stores the resulting handle at this+0x50 with the created flag byte at this+0x58, switches to the thread-object vtable off_59E4EC, and sets a 1.0f lock timeout at this+0x4; locking is entered through MutexLockWithTimeout (0x00406700).

compatibility_contracts.name: AudioDriverHandleContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The digital audio driver open flow must keep the sample-rate selector at this+0x54 (0 -> 11025, 1 -> 22050, otherwise 44100), store the AIL driver handle at this+0x90, clear nine state fields this+0x58..0x84 on success, install file callbacks (0x00405050 plus three literal addresses), and maintain the initialized flag at this+0x88 (1 success / 0 failure).

compatibility_contracts.name: AudioStreamOpenContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The audio-stream slot open flow must read the driver object at this+0x8 (handle at driver+0x90), the requested path at this+0x10, the mode byte at this+0x20 (0 = first-time data-driven open, non-zero = track update), the track index at this+0x1C and slot index at this+0x5C, store the AIL stream handle at this+0xC, set left/right volume from the float at this+0x4, and reset the three 20-byte slot groups on open failure.

compatibility_contracts.name: CameraViewportUpdateContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The per-frame camera update must gate on the context pointer at this+0x4, dispatch on the mode selector at this+0x34 to select one of the camera sub-object pointers at this+0x10..0x30, copy the rendered viewport triple from dword_7C54E0 + 88/92/96, clamp the mode-3 angle at sub-object +0xA0 into [-2.95, -0.050000001], apply the mirror flag at this+0x40 and Euler adjustments at this+0x44/0x48/0x4C, apply a negated chassis transform when the flag at context+0x1B0 is set, and sequence the mode-7/8 Y offset through dword_5BE900 with flt_5BE8FC.

compatibility_contracts.name: ViewModeFlagPairContract
compatibility_contracts.description: The enable/disable view-mode callbacks are a mutually exclusive pair: enable sets global flag bit 32 and clears bit 0x8000 at (dword_8AFE88 + 236); disable clears flag bit 32 and sets bit 0x8000. A replacement must keep these two operations exact inverses of each other.

compatibility_contracts.name: ContainerTeardownContract
compatibility_contracts.description: Container and list teardown must dispatch a virtual method on each live child/owned object (vtable slot 0, argument 1; argument 3 for the child at this+0x20), free node data only when the node ownership flag byte is set and the data pointer is non-null, and release list values through their vtable before freeing nodes.

unresolved: 0x00403540 (IndexRemappingWithStride): the parent/child/sibling meanings of the remapped links are a DERIVED reading; the concrete 316-byte sub-object type is unknown; why invalid indices are reset to -1 while the pointer is zeroed is unexplained.

0x00404AC0 (RenderNodeListDestructor): ConditionalFreeWithBit0Flag is called with literal 1 so the freed allocation is not identified here; obj+0x44/0x48/0x4C roles (tail/count/parallel arrays) are not established; result is uninitialized when *this is null.

0x00405440 (CameraViewStructInitializer): the destination buffer of StringCopyWithBufferRealloc is not evident; the -1 sentinel fields (0x0/0x10/0x1C) vs zeroed fields are inferred only from init literals.

0x004057F0 (AudioProcessingConfigInit): meanings of a3/a4/a5 and the two copied dwords depend on the caller config record at 0x00407810; the vtable object off_59E490 identity is DERIVED (Miles) not resolved here.

0x00406130 (MutexSynchronizationObjectInit): the three consecutive byte-store globals 0xFF00000000005450/451/452 are an extractor rendering of the entry byte-flag clears against an unknown base; the class identity and meaning of a2 come from caller 0x004078A0 (not in the allowed refs) and are unverified.

0x00406790 (OpenAndStartAudioStream): format constant contents (aSD_1/aSDDMp3) are inferred from decompiled format arguments; the field at this+0x5C as slot index is DERIVED; only the first 20-byte slot write site is named by the field table.

0x00406CC0 (AudioDriverInit): the three literal AIL_set_file_callbacks addresses (4215040/4215136/4215424) have no named refs; the nine zeroed state fields and flag this+0x88 semantics are not established; the vtable methods at *this+12 and *this+52 are unnamed.

0x00407C90 (LinkedListNodeRemovalWithVTableRelease): the virtual release target is indirect through the value vtable; the ownership flag and release argument 1 are inferred from the call shape; existing corpus analysis labels this a mutex/sync list with offsets shifted by 0x10 - not corroborated by this packet.
0x00407EF0 (BitfieldExtractFromStruct): the meaning of the extracted bit and the identity of the caller-supplied structure are unknown.

0x00407FB0 / 0x00408000 / 0x00408050 (linked-list lookups): field this+0x24 is listed as read-only in the packet facts but never read in the raw source; its role as a node count is unverifiable from this packet (the count is only decremented by 0x00407C90).

0x004083E0 (ResetStructWithConditionalNotify): the return value is uninitialized when the flag at 0x15 was already 0; global dword_8AD298 is flagged by packet facts but appears nowhere in the raw source.

0x004084B0 (LargeStructConstructorWithVTable): attribution to ChildContainer is a GUESS merge based on the shared vtable off_59E60C and the overlapping child-slot range this+0x10..0x30; the packet itself gives it UNKNOWN owner and sole caller sub_40C140 (0x0040C140).

0x00408520 (NotifyChildrenTeardown): the dispatched child methods are only vtable-slot 0 with arguments 1/3; the two container vtables off_59E60C/off_59E634 contents are unavailable; the return value is undefined when every child pointer is null.
0x00408740 (FloatKeyedFieldSelector): the nine selected fields and the 200-scaled case 4 are unconfirmed; the camera-shake interpretation is DERIVED prose, not runtime evidence.

0x00409950 / 0x004099E0 (view-mode callbacks): global dword_8AFE64 is listed in the packet globals but never referenced by the raw source; the object at dword_8AFE88 and the meaning of bit 0x8000 at offset 236 are unresolved.

0x00409A00 (CameraModeViewportUpdate): globals flt_59E440, flt_59E65C, flt_59E660, flt_59E664, flt_59E668, dword_8AD298 and dword_8AFE88 are recorded as read but absent from the decompiled text (likely folded constants); dword_5BE900 sequencing reset to 0 occurs outside this function; field:obj:0x00000014's owning object is unidentifiable.
General: the 28-byte record layout of F3DBufferMesh is inferred only from the zero-fill stride; no packet evidence proves common ownership between the different objects that share byte offsets.
No evidence in the packet establishes runtime truth; every class here except the three DERIVED owners is a GUESS proposal.
